note: Iowa DNR campground on the south shore of Black Hawk Lake, a 957-acre natural lake on the southeast edge of Lake View. One large campground of gravel pads off paved loops; the outer row of sites 35-50 backs onto open grass at the water's edge. Swim beach, boat ramp, fish cleaning station and disc golf beside it; the Sauk Trail passes nearby. Camp Crescent, on the north edge of the lake in town, is a separate campground. --Claude
summary: Hookups (electric 50, water, sewer), 128 sites to 90 ft with pull-throughs, facilities and season (Apr 1-Nov 30) confirmed from DNR/ReserveAmerica; stored 40-ft max corrected to 90. WATERFRONT LEAD not waterfront -> lakefront (official photos). PIN ~2.5 km off. Note rewritten (old season, 40-ft limit and 'screened from the lake' were wrong).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (not waterfront -> lakefront): ReserveAmerica's official photos of sites 036, 038, 040, 042, 044, 047 and 049 each show the pad backing from the loop road onto open mown grass that runs straight to the open lake a few metres past the picnic table; imagery puts those pad ends ~10-15 m from the waterline with no road, driveway or path between. Candidates on the lake side of the outer road per the DNR map: sites 35-50 (16) plus 114-116 (115's photo shows the lake past two big trunks). RA tags every site 'Near Water - no', which the photos contradict. The swim beach is separate, at the east end. Black Hawk Lake is 957 acres.

PIN: stored 42.30143,-95.04794 is in the woods west of the Lake View industrial yard, ~2.5 km WNW of the campground. Correct to ~42.2927,-95.0189 (centre of the loops; Google's place for the park is 42.29287,-95.01883).
